The scheme

Option

The final scheme. A new 4 × 4 × 2.5 m kiosk replaces the 2.6 m LV kiosk and is built around the existing board, which stays where it is. The new extension panel stands back-to-back behind it and is worked through doors in the west wall. Two DCX Hydro 200 racks face the yard doors across the miner aisle, the DCX Hydro 100 with the pumps stands on the south wall, and a walkable pipe aisle runs behind the racks. The heat goes up to a dry cooler on a steel gantry over the roof.
